# a2a-agent-card

> Build and validate A2A protocol Agent Cards against the v1.0.0 field rules, with JSON-path issues, media type and URL checks and the well-known discovery URL Python package `trysac-a2a-agent-card`, import name `a2a_agent_card`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
